info.description:
# databricks-vectorsearch (deprecated — please install `databricks-ai-search`)

This package is **deprecated**. The product previously known as Databricks
Vector Search has been renamed to **Databricks AI Search**, and the canonical
Python SDK is now published as
[`databricks-ai-search`](https://pypi.org/project/databricks-ai-search/).

```bash
pip install databricks-ai-search
```

`databricks-vectorsearch` is preserved as a thin re-export shim that
transparently forwards to `databricks-ai-search` and emits a
`DeprecationWarning` on import. Existing imports under
`databricks.vector_search.*` continue to work indefinitely; new code should
migrate to `databricks.ai_search.*`:

```python
# Before:
from databricks.vector_search.client import VectorSearchClient

# After:
from databricks.ai_search.client import AISearchClient

# Both still work — VectorSearchClient is preserved as a backward-compat
# alias of AISearchClient (same class, isinstance checks pass either way).
```
